about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Hi there! Let me tell you a little bit about myself and my love for creating magical stories.

introduction.title: Hello! I'm Hania
introduction.subtitle: 9-year-old author and dreamer
introduction.description1: I'm a 9-year-old girl who absolutely <1>loves</1> creating stories! Ever since I learned to write, I've been filling notebooks with tales of magic, adventure, and friendship.
introduction.description2: My imagination is full of talking animals, brave princesses, magical gardens, and wonderful places where anything is possible. I believe that every story has the power to make someone smile, dream, or feel a little braver.

writing.title: My Writing
writing.description: I love writing about brave characters who go on amazing adventures. My stories usually have happy endings because I think the world needs more joy and magic!

inspiration.title: My Inspiration
inspiration.description: I get ideas from everywhere - my dreams, walks in the park, playing with my pets, and reading other amazing books. Sometimes I write stories about my own adventures too!

writingMusic.title: Writing Music
writingMusic.description: I love listening to fairy tale soundtracks

dreamGoal.title: Dream Goal
dreamGoal.description: To publish a real book someday!

message.title: A Message for You
message.text1: Thank you for visiting my website and reading my stories! I hope they bring a little magic and happiness to your day. Remember, you're never too young or too old to believe in magic and follow your dreams.
message.text2: Keep reading, keep dreaming, and never stop believing in yourself! ✨
